criteria.statement: apps/frontend/public/robots.txt exists, permits crawling, and declares no sitemap
apps/frontend/public/.well-known/security.txt exists with Contact: https://mtgjudge.gg/, a Send-feedback comment line, an Expires: date, and no email address
A build-time test proves the dotted .well-known/ directory is copied into apps/frontend/dist/ by the production build
The same test asserts apps/frontend/dist/robots.txt exists and matches the public/ source
